_comment: Example configuration of runtime/migration on a fictional base: the notes folder of a small order-handling product ('old-notes') moves into a team knowledge base ('kb'). Keys starting with '_' are notes. Every value here is case data: a real case keeps its own file next to its manifest, outside the kit.
name: old-notes

provenance.author: dev-p
provenance._author: who wrote the knowledge (not who changed the code); omit the key when the old store has many authors

rewrites._why: the old store's machine root becomes a retired-reference marker; a rewrite changes addresses only, never meaning
